origin.description: Test whether each element is valid UTF-8.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Text, or a vector of text. bytes are tested by decoding.

origin.details: A string declared as bytes can still contain valid UTF-8 bytes.
origin.value: TRUE or FALSE for each element.

translation.description: A str is valid. bytes must decode as UTF-8.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Text, or a vector of text. bytes are tested by decoding.

translation.details: An invalid byte sequence is false. A Unicode string is true.
translation.value: TRUE or FALSE for each element.
translation.example:
from utf8 import utf8_valid
print(" ".join("TRUE" if item else "FALSE" for item in utf8_valid(["fa\u00e7ile", "abc"])))
